terms.comment: Short for cāsus vocātīvus, the case of calling: ō magister (Traupman 221).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 221, p. 249.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
